job.title: Technical Case Handler
job.description:

  • Provide regular updates and support to customers throughout their journey.
  • Liaise with surveyors, contractors, legal representatives, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records and update internal systems.
  • Escalate issues and delays where necessary.
  • Support complaint resolution and Housing Ombudsman cases.
To be considered for the Technical Case Handler:
  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational abilities.
  • Confident using Microsoft Office and IT systems.
  • Experience within case management or social housing is desirable.
Key Information Technical Case Handler role:
  • Hourly rate of £16.28 per hour.
  • Temporary role with the potential of becoming permanent.
  • Friendly support team and full training provided.
  • Parking onsite.
For more Information on the role, contact Reiss on reiss@kateandco.com or on  01217050077. Unsuccessful applications will be kept on file for future vacancies.

job.title: M&A Manager
job.description:
Our client, a leading boutique corporate finance advisory firm in the Midlands, is seeking to appoint a M&A Manager to support the continued growth of its practice. This is a key appointment, offering the opportunity to work closely with highly experienced Partners and to play a central role in the origination and execution of high-quality mid-market transactions.
Responsibilities
  • Leading and managing transactions across M&A, disposals, acquisitions, and fundraising mandates
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to clients, developing and maintaining strong relationships with business owners, management teams, and private equity investors
  • Taking responsibility for the full deal lifecycle, including financial analysis, valuations, preparation of marketing materials, negotiation, and project management
  • Contributing to business development initiatives and supporting the growth of the firm's client network
  • Coaching, developing, and providing guidance to junior members of the team
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  • Significant corporate finance, M&A, or transaction services experience gained within a professional advisory environment
  • Strong technical capability, with a proven track record of leading transactions to completion
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build long-term client relationships at a senior level
  • Professional qualification (ACA/ACCA or equivalent) preferred
  • Commercial awareness, ambition, and the ability to thrive in a boutique environment where quality of service and delivery are paramount
This role offers exposure to a wide range of high-quality transactions within a dynamic and collaborative environment. It provides clear progression towards Associate Director level, alongside a competitive package and performance-related incentives.

job.title: Client Accounting Manager
job.description:
KC Group is working with a leading firm who are looking for a Client Accounting Manager to join their growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for an ACA/ACCA qualified professional to develop their career across accountancy and business advisory, while building strong, long-term relationships with clients across the rural sector.
 
The role offers excellent career development opportunities, flexible and hybrid working arrangements, and the opportunity to become a valued adviser to a diverse portfolio of rural and agricultural businesses.
 
As Client Accounting Manager, you'll take responsibility for a mixed portfolio of clients, providing high-quality accounting, tax and commercial advice.
 
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Overseeing the preparation and completion of annual accounts and business tax computations for a varied client portfolio.
  • Providing advice on annual remuneration planning and profit forecasts.
  • Advising clients on capital taxes and reviewing VAT returns.
  • Building and maintaining strong, trusted client relationships.
  • Identifying opportunities to add value through tax planning and wider commercial advice.
  • Supporting clients with their broader business objectives and helping them achieve their goals.
  • Mentoring and supporting junior members of the team, helping them develop their skills and careers.
 
What We're Looking For
 
We're looking for someone who combines strong technical accountancy skills with a genuine interest in working with rural and agricultural businesses. You'll ideally have:
  • ACA, ACCA or equivalent qualification.
  • Experience working with clients in the agricultural and rural business sector.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to develop lasting client relationships.
  • A commercial mindset and the confidence to identify opportunities to add value.
  • Sound working knowledge of Excel, Xero and Sage.
 
Benefits package includes:
  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
  • On-site parking or a contribution towards parking, depending on location
  • Profit share scheme
  • 25-28 days' annual leave, with the option to purchase up to a total of 30 days
  • Clear career progression structure
  • Life assurance - 6x annual salary
  • Health and wellbeing benefits
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Regular firm-wide and team social events
  • Opportunities to attend and represent the firm at rural and agricultural industry events
